$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: Group id, e.g. "sorcerer-spells". Capabilities are keyed by their id.

name.description: Display name of the group (docs and debug tools).

notes.description: What the group covers and where it comes from, for review.

id.description: Capability id: verb., spell., arrow., tool., trick., technique. or sense. then a name.

description.description: What the capability lets the player do in the world, for designers and review.

nameKey.description: Localisation key of the display name; absent = "capability.<id>.name".

descKey.description: Localisation key of the description; absent = "capability.<id>.desc".

icon.description: UI icon id (hotbar, prompts); absent = the family icon.

classAffinity.description: The class whose fantasy it belongs to (ADR-0004); absent = any class.

crossClass.description: Other classes may learn it through the same source (ADR-0004 "simple" rule); default false.

supporting.description: A supporting (numeric) entry rather than a verb (ADR-0004 P1, P2); default false.
